description: Abstract class for managing version control settings, including retrieving, saving, and deleting settings associated with tenants, utilizing caching and admin settings service.

classes.name: TbAbstractVersionControlSettingsService
classes.description: Abstract generic service class for managing version control settings with caching and persistence.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves settings for a tenant, utilizing cache and loading from admin settings service if not present.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves settings for a tenant, updating admin settings service and evicting cache.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes settings for a tenant and evicts cache.
